title: 第9章 震惊全场这么快第10章 灵根测试赵元麟
content_zh:
;;
这个时候李观棋也明白了，其实灵符燃烧多少根本没有任何影响。
就像是李盛安，手里就剩下指甲大小的黄符纸，同样通过了第一关考验。
这连关卡都不算的一个考验，只是在测试所有拜宗弟子的心性罢了。
两个时辰的时间，就算中途休息一炷香，只要不放弃，是肯定能够完成的。
所以这一关就是考验所有人的毅力罢了。
一路上不少人都在纷纷议论着刚刚发生的事情。
对于一个木生火的双系真灵根弟子，竟然说不要就不要！
如此看来大夏剑宗真的是一个很特别的宗门。
这要是换做其他宗门，肯定会抢着收罗虎为徒，说不定还有可能成为炼丹师呢。
而且杂系真灵根和木火真灵根的差距可不是一点半点。
这是属于相生灵根，修炼速度仅次于单系天灵根的存在。
不过大夏剑宗如此作为，更是让许多平民百姓出身的子弟感受到了一种‘公平！’
没错，就是公平！
就像周致口中所说一样，大夏剑宗并非是那种看灵根看出身的宗门之地。
可是如此作为也变相的推开了许多有天赋的弟子。
周致和姜素并肩而立，姜素低声道：“每年都会经历一次这样的事情，呵呵。”
周致面色刚毅，沉声道：“所以我们大夏剑宗虽说人数不多，但宗门内部却十分团结！”
“这叫取其精华去其糟粕。”
李观棋没有注意到，人群中有一个面冠如玉的青年眼神一直飘向他。

没一会，李观棋瞬间朝着身后看去，却没有发觉有什么异样。
李盛安此时满脸笑意，恰好看到眉头皱起的李观棋。
“嗯？怎么了观棋。”
李观棋眉头舒展，微微一笑道：“没什么，就是感觉总有人在看我。”
拉着李观棋衣角的李盛安顿时一惊，惊呼道：“啊？你看得见？”
少年咧嘴一笑指了指自己的眼睛。
“看不见，我是真瞎子。”
李盛安将信将疑的点点头，随后忍不住叹道。
“也不知道我这三系杂灵根，能不能通过灵根测试。”
李观棋闻言问道：“怎么？很难么？”
此话一出就连一旁的林东都不由得出声说道：“难道你对这些一点都不了解么？”
李观棋耸了耸肩，他只是偶尔会听爷爷说一些。
不过他那时候贪玩，听了个囫囵吞枣。
而且他自己也不知道自己有没有灵根，苏玄也没说过。
每次他问的时候，苏玄都只是微微一笑，并不多言。
然而李观棋还不知道，他将会在这次的灵根测试上都看到什么。
这也让所有人都知晓了一些关于修真界的隐秘！
当所有人来到天子山的时候，宗门之中的各峰长老早已再次等候。
宗门的旗帜之上有着一个大大的夏字，两侧是两柄长剑。
方圆千丈的广场之上，此时有着八个测灵台。

每一座灵台之上都有一个透明的水晶球。
李观棋开启心眼看到高台之上很多仙风道骨的长老也是一愣。
他没想到这拜宗一事竟然会这么受重视。
李盛安或许是看出了李观棋的疑惑，轻声解释道：“不用觉得太大张旗鼓了。”
“有些宗门在广收门徒之日甚至宗主都会亲自到场。”

At this time, Li Guanqi also understood that in fact, the amount of burning of the talisman had no effect at all.
Just like Li Sheng'an, only the yellow talisman paper the size of a fingernail was left in his hand, but he also passed the first test.
This is not even a test, it is just testing the character of all disciples who worship the sect.
In two hours, even if you take a break to burn incense in the middle, as long as you don't give up, you will definitely be able to complete it.
So this level is just a test of everyone’s perseverance.
Along the way, many people were talking about what just happened.
For a dual-system true spiritual root disciple who has wood and fire, he doesn't want it even if he says he doesn't want it!
From this point of view, Daxia Sword Sect is really a very special sect.
If it were other sects, they would definitely be rushing to recruit Luo Hu as a disciple, and maybe even become an alchemist.
Moreover, the difference between the miscellaneous true spiritual roots and the wood-fire true spiritual roots is not the slightest bit.
This is a form of mutual spiritual root, and its cultivation speed is second only to the single-line Heavenly Spiritual Root.
However, what the Great Xia Jianzong did made many of the children of ordinary people feel a sense of ‘fairness! ’
That's right, it's fair!
Just like what Zhou Zhi said, Daxia Sword Sect is not the kind of sect that relies on its spiritual roots to determine its origin.
However, this kind of behavior also pushed away many talented disciples in disguise.
Zhou Zhi and Jiang Su stood side by side, and Jiang Su whispered: "I experience something like this once a year, haha."
Zhou Zhi looked resolute and said in a deep voice: "So although our Daxia Sword Sect has a small number of people, we are very united within the sect!"
"This is called taking the essence and discarding the dross."
Li Guanqi didn't notice that there was a young man with a jade-like face in the crowd who kept looking towards him.
After a while, Li Guanqi looked behind him, but didn't notice anything strange.
Li Sheng'an was smiling all over his face, and happened to see Li Guanqi, who was frowning.
"Huh? What's the matter? Watch chess."
Li Guanqi relaxed his brows and smiled slightly: "It's nothing, I just feel like someone is always looking at me."
Li Sheng'an, who was holding Li Guanqi's clothes, was startled and exclaimed: "Ah? Can you see it?"
The boy grinned and pointed at his eyes.
"I can't see, I'm really blind."
Li Sheng'an nodded doubtfully, and then couldn't help but sigh.
"I don't know if my three lines of miscellaneous spiritual roots can pass the spiritual root test."
Li Guanqi heard this and asked: "What? Is it difficult?"
As soon as these words came out, even Lin Dong on the side couldn't help but said aloud: "Don't you know anything about these?"
Li Guanqi shrugged. He only occasionally listened to what his grandfather said.
But he was playful at that time and swallowed everything he heard.
Moreover, he himself didn't know whether he had spiritual roots, and Su Xuan didn't say anything about it.
Every time he asked, Su Xuan just smiled and didn't say much.
However, Li Guanqi still doesn't know what he will see in this spiritual root test.
This also lets everyone know some secrets about the world of cultivation!
When everyone arrived at Tianzi Mountain, the elders from various peaks in the sect were already waiting again.
There is a large character Xia on the sect's flag, with two long swords on both sides.
On the square with a radius of thousands of feet, there are eight spirit detection platforms.
There is a transparent crystal ball on each spiritual platform.
Li Guanqi opened his mind and saw many immortal elders on the high platform who were also stunned.
He didn't expect that worshiping the clan would be taken so seriously.
Li Sheng'an may have noticed Li Guanqi's doubts, so he explained softly: "Don't think it's too grand."
"In some sects, even the sect leader will be present in person on the day when they recruit disciples."
